## Executive Summary

Mejbaur Bahar Fagun is an accomplished Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), Test Automation Architect, and Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) with over 6 years of experience engineering zero-defect test pipelines, designing enterprise Playwright/Cypress test frameworks, executing deep OWASP application security assessments, and evaluating production LLM/TTS AI models.

He is the Founder & Lead Architect of **SQATesting.com** (educating 50,000+ QA engineers monthly), creator of **Fagun MCP** (an open-source Model Context Protocol server enabling autonomous AI test automation), creator of **Bug Matrix** (a popular Chrome Web Store productivity extension for testers), and founder of **KoyJabo.com** (Bangladesh nationwide transit and route navigation platform).

---

## Core Competencies & Toolchain

### 1. Test Automation & SDET
- **Frameworks**: Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript & Python), Cypress (Cucumber BDD), Selenium WebDriver, Appium (Mobile Android & iOS)
- **Architecture**: Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven Testing, AI Self-Healing Locators, Parallel Sharding, Visual Regression (Pixelmatch)
- **Reporting & Telemetry**: Allure Reports, Playwright HTML Reports, Mochawesome, Video Tracing, Slack/Teams Alert Dispatch
- **Execution Speed**: Flakiness Rate < 0.08%, Regression runtime cut by up to 81%

### 2. Cybersecurity & Application Security (AppSec)
- **Certifications**: Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) by EC-Council, Certified AppSec Practitioner (CAP) by The SecOps Group
- **Specialties**: OWASP Top 10, Penetration Testing, Vulnerability Assessment, Burp Suite Professional, OWASP ZAP, SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, JWT Session Exploits, Security Code Reviews
- **Defensive Score**: 100% OWASP Juice Shop vulnerability coverage, automated security gates in CI/CD

### 3. AI & LLM Quality Engineering
- **Model QA**: Large Language Model (LLM) output validation, Text-to-Speech (TTS) prosody and latency benchmarking, hallucination reduction
- **Security & Safety**: Adversarial prompt injection testing, jailbreak mitigation, brand safety guardrails, semantic similarity benchmarks
- **Autonomous Agents**: Creator of Fagun MCP server allowing Claude, Cursor, and LLM agents to execute automated browser interactions and audits

### 4. Performance & Reliability Engineering
- **Load & Stress Testing**: Grafana k6, JMeter, InfluxDB, Grafana Dashboards
- **Scale**: Simulated 15,000+ concurrent Virtual Users (VUs) with p99 latency thresholds < 320ms

### 5. DevOps, Cloud & CI/CD
- **Tools**: GitHub Actions, Docker, Linux, Bash, Git, Jenkins, Webhooks, REST API Testing with Postman/Newman
